{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few values of revenue to confirm format
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"Revenue contains commas: {has_commas}")

# Confirm if all revenue values are valid numeric strings with commas
# Convert to float after removing commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any values are suspiciously large (e.g., 999999.99)
suspicious_revenue = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {suspicious_revenue}")"}
